correctness.rationale: Closed neighborhood equals clique column plus two adjacent same-row vertices; exact sign equations imply a recurrence on column sums. For m>=4 maximum modulus forces zero sums and period-four signs, counted by two balanced columns. For m=2 cyclic energy forces alternating sums; zero/nonzero dichotomy counts all solutions. Every construction satisfies all equations. Verifier independently checks 10 direct graphs and 40 seed-propagation cases; finite checks do not prove the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Exact solution classification and counts for a natural infinite two-parameter graph family give structural information beyond general decision complexity and existence. The four-periodic obstruction is sharp for all even clique widths at least four, while the thin prism family exhibits a separate two-versus-six count. The count binomial(m,m/2)^2 provides all labelled solutions constructively; neither ease of proof nor numerical verification alone is offered as value.
